title: Energy Independence In Asia
summary:
Vietnam's growth ambitions could change trade flows
Vietnam is an oil producer, crude oil importer and exporter. It plans to continue to invest in the petroleum sector. The country already boasts two refineries, but is planning to add more capacity since it still needs to import products.
